title: Cannot implicitly convert type

sourceOfTruth.rule: Inspect the producer and consumer signatures before changing assignments.
authoritativeInputs: compiler source and target type text

symptoms: A property or collection type changed between Core versions.
The caller expects the old contract.
investigation: Identify both sides of the failed assignment.
Decompile the method or property producing the new type.
Search for other callers already adapted to the new type.
Check whether a tuple, dictionary, or model/DTO split was introduced.
patchRules: Update the consuming code to the new contract with the smallest local change.
Preserve old behavior by extracting the equivalent member when return types became compound.
Update method signatures when the changed contract propagates through client abstractions.
antiPatterns: Do not cast between unrelated collection types.
Do not discard new return data unless the old behavior explicitly ignored it.
Do not rewrite caller logic beyond the changed contract.

successCriteria: Any propagated signature changes compile through callers.
